data.name: Ali
data.gender_notes: Ali is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ل-ي (ʿ-l-y), 'to be high, elevated'. ʿAlī means 'exalted, high, sublime'. Its root is ع-ل-ي (ʿ-l-y). Borne by ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, the fourth caliph and cousin of the Prophet ﷺ. Ali is a Arabic name meaning “Exalted; high; noble”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ali expresses “Exalted; high; noble”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-ل-ي (ʿ-l-y), 'to be high, elevated'. ʿAlī means 'exalted, high, sublime'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ali total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
